implementation.behavior: Enumerates physical tiles touched by explicit half-open logical-pixel rectangles and maps unique shared physical tiles between two such rectangles, including different tile-row coordinates caused by pitch and sample-count changes.
implementation.safety: Rejects invalid rectangles and any rectangle that maps multiple coordinates to the same physical tile. The API returns tile coordinates only; it does not claim a whole-tile transfer is valid when a rectangle covers only part of a tile.
implementation.runtime_effect: None. Ordered renderer alias admission remains fail-closed; color, depth, and stencil image transfer is not implemented by this change.

regression.classification: Address-map regression driven by captured retail register values; not a Vulkan image transfer, retail command execution, or pixel-parity result.
